what: M-WORM is an open-source groovebox inspired by the philosophy of Elektron machines. 6 tracks, 128 steps per pattern, 16 pattern, 8 banks, 1 project. 3 engines - Wavetable, Virtual Analog, FM. x 2 Filters + 2 ADSR, x2 AMP + x 2 ADSR (and FREE ADSR + mapping), x 4 LFO - 7 waveforms + MI Tides, Live mode + Live FX.
author: RAWJUNGLE
sounds: own: wavetables generated from my own source WAVs
